messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: PROD p99 spike detected for streaming endpoints (region: eu-west-1). Service: prefix-cache. p95 also elevated. Auto-alert created.

alicia-ng: oncall here, looking. seeing p99 ~ 3.4s -> baseline 600ms. rolling deploy of prefix-hash v2->v3 around 02:06 UTC?

carol_ops: yep, can confirm a canary pushed at 02:05. rollout at 02:12 to 30% traffic.

alicia-ng: loading logs, initial hypothesis: cache hitrate collapsed for several namespace shards. streaming tail requests are hitting backend instead of prefix cache.

ben-choi: are we seeing any error spikes or just latency?

alicia-ng: errors low, but tokenization / serving backend CPU ratcheting up. looks like many requests miss cache and cascade into paging + long decode paths.

carol_ops: quick metrics: prefix_cache_hit_rate by shard: shard-17 dropped from 92% -> 8% at 02:13. other shards trending normal.

alicia-ng: I suspect the new prefix-hash salt change combined with a TTL alignment bug. v3 changed the namespace salt -> effective key mismatch for ~20% of keys in shard-17 due to sharding boundary edge-case.

support-jen: any customer-impact ETA? a handful of customers on streaming show p99 errors in their dashboards. No P0 escalations yet but support seeing incoming alerts.

alicia-ng: impact: increased tail latency for streaming sessions that route to shard-17. Estimated affected traffic 6-8% of EU streaming queries. Not a complete outage but SLOs at risk.

carol_ops: mitigation options: 1) roll back prefix-hash v3 globally (fast, some churn), 2) enable legacy-prefix-fallback policy that attempts old-key lookup on miss (safer, code path exists), 3) per-shard rehash/rehydrate by running warmup sweep.

alicia-ng: I'm going to enable legacy-prefix-fallback on shard-17 and start a targeted warmup sweep. Doing a controlled change to avoid broad churn.

alicia-ng: (executing) `curl -XPOST https://ops-api.internal/feature_flags/legacy-prefix-fallback -d '{"enabled":true,"target_shards":[17]}'`

incidents-bot: Feature flag change accepted. propagation ~30s.

carol_ops: warmup sweep kickoff command: `./tools/cache_warmup --shard 17 --mode=streaming --rate=2000` (daemonized). starting now.

ben-choi: monitoring hit rate and p99. If fallback is good, hit-rate should recover and backend CPU should drop.

alicia-ng: after enabling fallback, shard-17 hit_rate jumped to 45% within 90s. p99 down from 3.4s -> 1.1s. warmup sweep still running.

support-jen: passing note to accounts team: some customers saw degraded p99 but not data loss. I'll post a brief note to affected customers and let them know mitigation in progress. :white_check_mark:

carol_ops: warmup finished. hit_rate now 87% shard-17. p95/p99 near baseline.

alicia-ng: current status: mitigation succeeded. fallback stay enabled for 2h while we prepare rollback plan for v3 rollout or patch v3 hashing.

ben-choi: adding runbook step: if we see >2% traffic with hit_rate<60% after fallback, escalate to full rollback.

sre-rotation-bot: assigning night oncall -> @ben-choi for 02:50 UTC handoff.

alicia-ng: handing to @ben-choi. I'll create a short incident summary and follow-up ticket for root cause of salt alignment bug.

alicia-ng: Incident summary (quick): p99 streaming spike caused by prefix-hash v3 salt boundary edge-case -> shard-17 key mismatch -> cache miss storm -> backend paging + tail latency. Mitigation: enabled legacy-prefix-fallback on shard-17, ran warmup sweep, observed hit rate recovery and p99 improvement. Next: patch v3 hashing logic to handle boundary keys, add canary checks for shard-specific hitrate deltas, and an automated revert if shard hit_rate delta > 20%.

support-jen: I've sent a brief to affected customers and noted there was no data loss; they'll get a follow-up once RCA is ready.

ben-choi: I'll monitor for the next 2 hours and then rotate to follow-up/triage morning. leaving notes in incident tracker: INC-2026X. handover done. :wave:

alicia-ng: thanks all. tagging for postmortem: @carol_ops, @ben-choi, @alicia-ng, @support-jen. please add logs/screenshots to INC-2026X.

incidents-bot: Incident resolved (mitigated). If any regression reoccurs, bot will reopen thread.
